name: byro
description: Use your confirmed Byro context to draft and check company communications, then send checked drafts to Byro for your review.

interface.longDescription: Read the Goal and facts your Byro workspace has confirmed, check a draft for flagged claims, and send a checked draft to Byro as a pending proposal for your review. Byro does not approve or publish from chat.
defaultPrompt: Show me my current Byro Goal and confirmed shareable facts.
Check this draft against my Byro context: [paste draft]
Help me draft a LinkedIn post using only my confirmed Byro facts. Show me the checked draft.
